actors.why: One row per actor keyed by actorid with gender and quality; movies2actors points at it.

directors.why: One row per director keyed by directorid with quality and revenue bands; movies2directors points at it.

movies.why: One row per film keyed by movieid with year band, language, country and running time; three link tables point at it.

movies2actors.why: Links movies to actors with a cast_num on the link; the pair is the key.

movies2directors.why: Links movies to directors with a genre on the link; the pair is the key.

u2base.why: Links users to movies with a rating on the link and no time column, the pair its key.

users.why: One row per user keyed by userid with age, gender and occupation codes; u2base points at it.
